record.label: Native22 late-q capacity ceiling
record.summary: The immutable exactly-once four-fold independent256 primary arm is a valid terminal failure. Its local q MSE is 5.298375774407814e-9 and its endpoint MSE is 2.988906304823771e-8 versus fold-J base 3.048918630419429e-8: a 1.968315% base improvement that closes only 2.464820% of the base-to-exact-q-oracle gap. The absolute local gate <=1.375544984492742e-9 and strict endpoint gate <1.2427319908150922e-8 both fail. The shared256 diagnostic is marginally better but is frozen diagnostic-only, also fails the absolute gates, and is nonselectable after results. This is a closed_measured missing-information boundary for native22, with no retry. A post-terminal observational trace, explicitly not a new gate, also shows normalized training q loss ending near 0.969-0.974, so even fit rows explain only about 2-3% of normalized q energy.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for the exact native22 independent256 capacity spelling under its immutable no-retry contract. Do not rerun, retune, select shared256, fit all 688, integrate, package, or submit. This closes native22 capacity only; it does not close q distillation or the distinct signed-pair Q1 information source.

observational_training_trace.interpretation: Even fit data explains only about 2-3% of normalized q energy, reinforcing the missing-information classification rather than a held-only overfit diagnosis. Shared256 remains diagnostic-only and nonselectable.
observational_training_trace.authority: Observational trace only; creates no gate, retry, model selection, execution, integration, package, or submission authority.
